phases.name: Mobilise
phases.description: Survey control and infection-control (ICRA) barrier set-up next to the live hospital.

phases.name: Substructure
phases.description: Excavation, piles, footings, ground slab and underground drainage.

phases.name: Superstructure
phases.description: Concrete frame, floor slabs with strike lag, cores and roof steel.

phases.name: Envelope
phases.description: External walls, curtain wall, windows and roof, closed in before services.

phases.name: MEP rough-in
phases.description: Partition framing, ducts, pipes, medical gas, sprinklers, trays, plant and electrical gear.

phases.name: Interiors
phases.description: Boarding, ceiling close-out, floors, doors and lead-lined walls.

phases.name: MEP finish
phases.description: Diffusers, light fittings, devices and plumbing fixtures.

phases.name: Medical equipment
phases.description: MRI, CT, sterilisers and fixed clinical equipment built into finished rooms.

phases.name: Commissioning
phases.description: Air balance, pressure tests, fire alarm, power and medical gas certification.

phases.name: ICRA close-out
phases.description: HEPA clean and infection control sign-off before barriers come down.

steps.name: Erect ICRA barrier and negative air
steps.description: Dust containment barrier with negative air next to the live hospital. Every dusty or noisy step in an occupied_adjacent zone waits for it.

steps.name: Lay underground drainage and service ducts
Fix slab reinforcement and services sleeves
Strike formwork
steps.description: Formwork can only be struck 7 days after the pour. Finishing and services work in the storey below waits for the strike above it.

steps.name: Build external wall and cladding
steps.description: External walls only start once the slab above is in place.

steps.name: Install roof deck, insulation and membrane
Frame partition walls
steps.description: Stud framing; track cutting and anchor drilling make dust, so ICRA applies.

steps.name: Set air handling unit or plant item
Install water, waste and heating pipe
Medical gas pressure test and purge
steps.description: Hold point: walls cannot be boarded and equipment cannot be installed until this passes.

steps.name: Fire-stop penetrations
steps.description: Fire-stopping of every wall penetration; inspected before the wall can be closed.

steps.name: Set transformer
steps.description: Longest lead item of the building services: 40 weeks.

steps.name: Board, tape and finish partition walls
Close ceiling
steps.description: Only after every service above the ceiling in the cell is installed and inspected.

steps.name: Install MRI scanner
steps.description: 26 week lead. Room must be shielded, floored and gas-tested before the magnet arrives.

steps.name: Install fixed clinical equipment
steps.description: Bed-heads, theatre lights, pendants, nurse-call and similar.

steps.name: Test and balance air system
steps.description: Air balancing must finish before the room can be handed over.

steps.name: Fire alarm and sprinkler acceptance test
Medical gas certification
steps.description: Third-party verification of purity, flow and alarms for every outlet.

steps.name: Room-by-room handover documentation
steps.description: Air balance, medical gas certificate and fire test must all be signed off first.

steps.name: Install miscellaneous element
steps.description: Default step for any element no rule matched. Shows up in the authoring feedback list.

gates.name: Foundations before frame
gates.description: Piles tested, footings and ground slab inspected and drains proven on the storey before columns go up.

gates.name: Weathertight before MEP rough-in
gates.description: Frame inspected and envelope closed on the storey before any services go in.

gates.name: Ceiling close-out gate
gates.description: Every rough-in inspection in the zone passed before boarding and ceilings close the services in.

gates.name: Rooms ready for clinical equipment
gates.description: Medical gas pressure test passed in the zone before any medical equipment is installed.

gates.name: Strict commissioning gate
gates.description: Pressure tests, air balance, fire test and medical gas certification complete before ICRA barriers come down.

gates.name: ICRA sign-off before handover
gates.description: Infection control clearance for every occupied-adjacent zone before documents are issued.

sequence_cards.name: Operating room recipe
sequence_cards.description: Frame, rough-in, fire-stop and gas test, lead lining, ceilings, hygienic floors, fixtures, equipment, pressure test and commissioning.

sequence_cards.name: Imaging suite recipe
sequence_cards.description: MRI and CT rooms: shielded walls, services, floors, then the long-lead scanner install before commissioning.

sequence_cards.name: Plant room recipe
sequence_cards.description: Plant set first, then pipework, ductwork and electrical, tests, enclosing finishes and commissioning.

sequence_cards.name: Ward floor recipe
sequence_cards.description: Generic repeating recipe for ward, corridor and clinic zones.
